In a hidden cave beneath {wiki:Mt. Sternum}, east of Thais, the guardian {npc:Skjaar} will only hand over the crypt key to those who prove they knew his master, the mage Dago. Pay 1000 gp, answer the quiz, pass the level 35 door and open the chests to receive a {item:Noble Armor} and a {item:Crown Helmet}.
to pay for Skjaar's test and receive Key 3142
**Before** you pay for Skjaar's test, check whether the door of the chest room is unlocked. If it is open, you could waste 1000 gp for nothing.
Alternatively, you can go through the {wiki:Mount Sternum Undead Cave}: that way you only face {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}.

Enter through the **west entrance** of Mount Sternum and go down the stairs. {wiki:Mount Sternum} is the mountain **northeast** of Thais (on the way to Kazordoon): leave Thais and head northeast to the west entrance.

Start by going **west** and follow the path on the map (you start at the stars and go up/down at the arrows). On the first floor you will find a few {creature:Cyclops}. On floor -2 there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and a few {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}.
Route to Skjaar: you start at the stars and go up/down at the arrows
Depending on the path, you may also find {creature:Cyclops Smith|Cyclops Smiths} and {creature:Cyclops Drone|Cyclops Drones}.
Skjaar only lets you through if you prove that you knew his master, the mage Dago. Answers: {key:redips}, {key:7} and {key:black}.
Before you talk to Skjaar, go and check whether the door of the chest room is unlocked. If it is, skip the quiz and save 1000 gp.
Talk to {npc:Skjaar} and say: {key:hi}, {key:key}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} (you pay 1000 gp), {key:redips}, {key:7}, {key:black} and {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Key 3142}.

A gravestone in the {wiki:Graveyard of the Doomed} says that the greatest mage's favourite spider lies there. {npc:Hoggle} ({key:pet names}) tells you that the mage gave creatures the name of their species backwards: *spider* backwards is *redips*.
How many fingers he had when he died
Another gravestone holds Dago's thumb, lost in a battle with a demon. {npc:Lubo} ({key:finger}) tells you he lost two more fingers when conjuring a dragon: 10 - 1 - 2 = 7.
Colour of the demons he specialised in

The book {item:How to Summon Black Demons (Book)|How to Summon Black Demons}, written by Dago, is in the hidden room of the Demon Skeletons under Mount Sternum. Lubo ({key:magician}) says his banner was the black eye.
Pass the level 35 {wiki:Gate of Expertise} and use the {item:Key 3142} to enter the crypt.
Inside the quest room there are 4 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}. Kill them.
Open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chests} in the **south** to receive the {item:Noble Armor} and the {item:Crown Helmet}.

North of the quest chests there is another chest, on top of fire. It has a {item:Short Sword}, 8 {item:Poison Arrow|Poison Arrows}, 34 gp and a {item:White Pearl}. This chest refreshes every day ({wiki:Daily Respawn|daily respawn}).
The chest is on top of fire: you will take damage when picking it up.

Go back along the same path on the map, in reverse: go up the floors you came down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes where needed) to the west entrance of Mount Sternum and return to Thais, to the **southwest**.
